title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
Article 3 (Timing of Payment of Allowances)
(1) The fixed allowance under Article 2 (1) shall be paid beginning with the month in which the member was elected, and the position allowance under Article 2 (3) shall be paid beginning with the month in which the term of office of the elected president or vice president commences: Provided, That where a member, president or vice president whose term has expired is reelected to the same position and the new term commences in the month in which the former term expired, payment shall begin in the following month. <Amended on January 29, 1996.>
(2) The fixed allowance under Article 2 (1) and the position allowance under Article 2 (3) shall be paid on the 16th of each month: Provided, That where the payment day falls on a holiday, payment shall be made on the preceding day.
